claims.exact_statement: The paid-boundary stopping assembly correctly derives U(f)<=[max(A,kappa)I(f)+(2/ln2)Var(f)]/(1-b) and the stated FEI constant from its aggregate residual and terminal hypotheses. It does not prove those hypotheses universally.
claims.first_unproved_line: Universal existence of a finite physical tree with fixed A,kappa,b<1 satisfying the aggregate signed residual and terminal bounds.
